description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named 'TaxClassController' responsible for handling administrative operations related to tax classes in an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for listing, paging, creating, updating, editing, and deleting tax classes, with access control annotations and integration with service layers and view templates.

classes.name: TaxClassController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing tax classes in the admin panel. Handles CRUD operations, listing, and pagination requests with security annotations.

methods.name: displayTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of tax classes in the admin UI.

methods.name: pageTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles POST request to get a paginated JSON list of tax classes.

methods.name: saveTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new tax class after form validation.

methods.name: updateTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing tax class.

methods.name: removeTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a tax class, with checks for usage and permissions.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Handles GET request to load tax class data for editing.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set navigation menu attributes in the model.
